description: Send the browser build for a version and publish it. One HTML file, or a zip with index.html at its root. When approved, the result has `live: true` and `playPath`. Otherwise `live: false` and `waiting` says why, either a list of things to fix or that this arcade reviews that upload by hand. Also returns file count, size, engine and whether the arcade SDK was detected. If the zip has several pages and no index.html, the result asks which page starts it — answer with set_entry.

content_base64.description: The .html or .zip file, base64 encoded. Up to 24 MB decoded.

entry.description: Start page inside a zip, if it is not index.html.

filename.description: The file's name, so the type is read correctly: e.g. index.html or build.zip.

threads.description: True if the build needs SharedArrayBuffer. Threaded builds open in their own tab and cannot use the SDK bridge. Omit to work it out from the files.

version.description: Version id from create_experience or start_version.

name: upload_build
title: Upload a build
